title: About Me
subtitle: Frontend developer with 9+ years of experience building modern, scalable web applications
paragraph: I am a frontend developer who thrives on turning complex challenges into simple, user-friendly solutions. My journey in web development began 9 years ago, and since then I've been dedicated to crafting seamless digital experiences.

I specialise in Angular and React, combining modern frameworks with best practices to deliver performant, accessible, and maintainable applications. My goal is always to balance clean code with intuitive design.
